item.title: Bronze Medalist
item.description: Tonga has ended a 16-year Commonwealth Games medal drought after heavyweight judoka Paula Monta claimed a historic bronze medal in the men's +100kg competition at the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games. Paula Monta became Tonga's first and only medalist of the Commonwelath Games since 2010 after defeating Canada's John Messe Bessong in a hard-fought bronze medal contest.
item.content:encoded:
Tonga has ended a 16-year Commonwealth Games medal drought after heavyweight judoka Paula Monta claimed a historic bronze medal in the men's +100kg competition at the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games.

Paula Monta became Tonga's first and only medalist of the Commonwelath Games since 2010 after defeating Canada's John Messe Bessong in a hard-fought bronze medal contest.

The encounter went the full distance, with Monta holding off a late challenge from the Canadian Judoka to secure victory by the narrowest of margins. He prevailed with one waza-ari and two yuko to Bessong's one waza-ari and one yuko.

The bronze medal is a remarkable campaign for the 21-year-old, who fought his way through the repechage after an earlier defeat to earn another chance at the podium before delivering under pressure in the medal playoff.

The result ends the nation's 16-year wait for a Commonwealth Games medal and providing Team Tonga with its first podium finish of the Glasgow Games.

Monta's success follows months of preparation in Japan under the guidance of coach Josateki Naulu, the former Fiji international judoka and Olympian. The Tonga Judo Association credited Naulu's dedication and expertise as instrumental in preparing Monta for the historic performance.

In recognition of his achievement, Monta was also named Tonga's flag bearer for Team Tonga in the Commonwealth Games closing ceremony.

The Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games officially concluded on Sunday, August 2, 2026, with a vibrant closing ceremony inside the OVO Hydro arena in Glasgow, Scotland. The 11-day sporting event wrapped up with musical performances, athlete parades, and the formal handover of the Commonwealth Games flag to the next host city.

Amdavad (Ahmedabad), India, will host the Centenary Games in 2030.

item.title: Public Notice of a Development Application for proposed quarry at Vaini
item.description: The Ministry of Meteorology, Energy, Information, Disaster Management, Environment, Climate Change & Communications ( MEIDECC ) has received an Environmental Impact Assessment ( EIA ) Report for a Proposed Quarry at Vaini, Tongatapu by Kiwi Tonga Limited . EIA Project No. 210/2025 - 26. MEIDECC is seeking comments on this EIA report.
item.content:encoded:
The Ministry of Meteorology, Energy, Information, Disaster Management, Environment, Climate Change & Communications ( MEIDECC ) has received an Environmental Impact Assessment ( EIA ) Report for a Proposed Quarry at Vaini, Tongatapu by Kiwi Tonga Limited . EIA Project No. 210/2025 - 26.

MEIDECC is seeking comments on this EIA report.

A copy of the ElA Report may be inspected at the MEIDECC Environment Office, Fatafehi Road, Nuku'alofa, Tongatapu. The EIA report can only be assessed in the Tongatapu office.

Comments must be received by 21 st August 2026.

If you need directions, call 7400080 and speak to Ms Kelelia 'Apikotoa.

Thank you - EIA Unit of the Department of Environment.

Kuo fakahü mai ki he Potungăue MEIDECC 'a ē 'oku fakamalumalu ai e Va Fakamatala ea, Ma'u'anga Ivi, Ma'u'anga Fakamatala, Ofisi Tokangaekina 'a e Ngaahi Fakatamaki Fakaenatula, 'Atakai, Feliuliuaki 'o e 'Ea pea mo e Fetu'utaki, ha Lipooti Fakafuofua 'o e ngaahi uesia ki he 'Ätakai (or EIA report) ki he Polöseki Keli'anga Maka Fo'ou ‘i Vaini, Tongatapu 'a e Kiwi Tonga Limited.

' Oku fakaafe'i atu heni 'a e kakai 'o e fonua ke fakahoko mai ha nau faka'eke' eke ki he fakaikiiki ‘o e lipooti ni, 'a ia ko e Polöseki EIA fika 210/2025-26.

' Oku 'ată pe 'a e 'ofisi 'Atakai, 'a ia oku tu'u i he hala Fatafehi, Nuku'alofa, Tongatapu, ke ke lava mai ki ai 'o sivisivi'i 'a e lipooti, fai ha'o faka'eke' eke pe koe fakafehu'i fekau'aki mo e lipooti ni.

Ko e ngaahi fehu'i, faka'eke' eke pe fie'ilo ki he lipooti ni, 'e ngata pe ‘i he 'aho 21 ‘o Aokosi 2026 .

Ka fiema'u ha fakahinohino kihomau 'ofisi, fetu'utaki ki he 7400080/7400071 kia Kelelia 'Apikotoa.

Malo 'aupito - Va'a Ngaue EIA 'o e Potungaue 'Atakai.
